title: HarnessIPCProtocol
transport: newline-delimited JSON over TCP; one request {id, method, params} per line, one response {id, result, error} per line

cmd.description: Executable to run. Must be non-empty.

exit_code.description: Process exit code; -1 if killed by signal or after a timeout.

timed_out.description: True if the command was killed after 60s.

errors.non-zero exit: reported through result.exit_code, NOT through the error field
errors.timeout: error field is set and result.timed_out is true
errors.spawn failure: error field is set and result is null
